description: Geology is the study of the Earth: what geologists do, reading geologic maps, one in-depth track — surface and sedimentary processes, energy resources, mineral resources, or Earth history and fossils — outdoor ethics while collecting, and careers.

safety.note: Collect specimens only where it is allowed, wear eye protection when breaking rocks, and stay away from cliffs and unstable slopes.

outlineNote: Requirements 3–6 were revised for 2026 (including a new careers item), and the excerpts mixed the old and new versions, so no requirement outline is published yet.
